source_note: Response-plan templates for Vidura step 7X. Placeholders in {braces} are filled by the engine from computed paths and cascades, never hand-written. Regulatory lines cite CERT-In Directions of 28 April 2022 under Section 70B of the IT Act, 2000 (report within 6 hours of noticing; keep logs 180 days within India).

common_steps.step: Confirm the alert with the operator on site: is {asset} behaving abnormally (setpoints, alarms, unexpected commands)?
Cut the attacker's most likely way in: isolate {entry_point} (block the rule or disable the account/VPN profile), without breaking required flows: {required_flows_kept}.
Preserve evidence: export logs from {asset}, {entry_point} and every host on the path ({path_hosts}); keep them for at least 180 days, within India.

Report the incident to CERT-In within 6 hours of noticing it (CERT-In Directions, 28 April 2022). If the system is notified as a protected system under Section 70 of the IT Act, also follow NCIIPC's reporting requirements.
Warn the services that depend on {asset} before their buffers run out: {dependent_services_with_hours}.
Restore {asset} from a known-good configuration/program backup; change every credential used on the path; only then reconnect.

water_pump_plc: Switch pumps to local/manual control at the plant; station an operator at the pump panel.
Watch service-reservoir levels; the scenario buffer is about {buffer_hours} h before households lose supply.
Arrange water tankers for the hospital and for informal settlements first, as they have the least storage.
After pumping is restored following a long outage, flush and test before declaring the water safe: depressurised mains in intermittent systems can draw in contaminated water.
chlorine_dosing_plc: Switch dosing to manual and start grab sampling of residual chlorine at the plant outlet and at the first tap points.
If dosing was wrong for any period, hold or divert treated water and prepare a boil-water advisory with the health department before it reaches taps (scenario travel time about {delay_hours} h).
Flush affected mains and test before lifting any advisory.
substation_rtu_or_relay: Move breaker operation to local control in the substation; block remote commands from the SCADA server until it is verified.
Check protection relay settings against the approved settings file before re-energising feeders.
Prioritise restoration of the feeders supplying the water plant and the hospital.
hospital_generator_controller: Test-start the backup generator manually now, before any grid event; confirm diesel stock for {generator_hours} h.
Put the generator controller in local mode and keep an electrician on site until it is verified.
hospital_bms_or_medical_iot: Switch air handling for theatres and ICU to manual override; postpone non-emergency surgery if theatre pressure cannot be held.
For medical-device monitoring, move to bedside alarms and nurse rounds; do not reconnect the gateway until verified.
traffic_signal_controller: Ask traffic police to take manual control of the affected junctions, starting with ambulance routes to the hospital.
Put controllers into fixed-time local mode, disconnected from the central server.
vendor_remote_access: Disable the vendor VPN profile and any shared vendor accounts; tell the vendor to use escorted, time-limited access only after review.
Review every session from the vendor gateway in the logs for the last 30 days.
